assessment.rationale: No self-cleaning, dust-proof panel is deployed at scale, so the Main KPI of 300,000 MW of desert solar with no water cleaning is not met by the project's approach. The panel-intrinsic routes remain research: MIT's electrostatic dust removal (2022, patent pending, no commercial launch found, https://www.technologyreview.com/2022/04/27/1048479/a-better-way-to-clean-solar-panels), electrodynamic screens with small field trials only (Sol Clarity, 11 panels; Brunel 2025 simulation, https://bura.brunel.ac.uk/handle/2438/33024), and anti-soiling coatings whose multi-year desert durability is unproven (CSU thesis, https://mountainscholar.org/handle/10217/195368). Honest limit: the 'no water' half of the KPI is partly answered by deployed waterless robotic cleaning (Ecoppia, about 99% dust removal claimed, https://www.pv-tech.org/news/ecoppia-installs-cleaning-robots-for-40mw-solar-plant-on-israel-jordan-bord; Noor Abu Dhabi's 1,430 dry robots, https://noorabudhabi.ae/plants/robotic-cleaning-system/). I found no total for GW served by waterless robots and cannot rule out that it is a large fraction of MENA desert PV; it is not shown to reach 300 GW. Tasks must not reward re-inventing waterless robots and must target durable panel-intrinsic dust rejection with their own prior-art basis.

additionalSearches.query: waterless solar panel cleaning robots deserts deployed GW Ecoppia 2026
additionalSearches.finding: Ecoppia waterless robots deployed at tens-of-MW sites in Israel and Middle East; no GW-scale total found; robots, not self-cleaning panels.

additionalSearches.query: electrostatic dust removal solar panels MIT waterless self-cleaning commercialization
additionalSearches.finding: MIT electrostatic system recovers about 95% of lost power for particles over 30 um in the lab; patent pending; no commercial deployment found.

additionalSearches.query: anti-soiling superhydrophobic coating solar module desert field test durability
additionalSearches.finding: Research has not conclusively shown hydrophobic coatings survive a module lifetime outdoors; desert durability mostly lab abrasion tests.

additionalSearches.query: electrodynamic screen solar panel dust shield field deployment 2025 2026
additionalSearches.finding: Electrodynamic screens: 2025 self-powered EDS design is simulation only; Sol Clarity field test of 11 panels; no large-scale installations found.

additionalSearches.query: gigawatt solar plant waterless robotic cleaning Al Dhafra Sudair Middle East robots GW installed
additionalSearches.finding: Noor Abu Dhabi uses 1,430 dry cleaning robots on 3.3 million panels; Al Dhafra 2 GW also robot-cleaned. Waterless robots are deployed prior art for the no-water part.
